SD6200
4U 90 HDD Dense Storage SAS-4 Expansion System




SD6200 is a next-generation 4U rackmount                     FEATURES
SAS-4 storage expansion system for the                          4U enclosure designed to fit in standard 19” wide rack
enterprise. SD6200 can be configured with up                    Cable management assembly (CMA)
to 90 SAS HDDs or SSDs to maximize storage                      Supports up to 90 12G SAS or 6G SATA 3.5” or
density and OPEX savings.                                       2.5” drives
                                                                SCSI Enclosure Services
The SD6200 is ideal for:                                        13W max drive power at 35C
                                                                Power control for 12G SAS drive via pin3
•   Back-up/Restore & Disaster Recovery (DR)
                                                                Dual redundant ESMs, hot-swappable
•   HPC & AI
                                                                Single ESM configuration supported
•   Hyperscale / Hyperconverged infrastructure
    applications                                                ESM (Expansion SAS Module)
•   Enterprise Data Center                                       Four 24G SAS4 capable mini-SAS HD ports per ESM
•   Software-Defined Storage                                     One RJ45 for management
                                                                 One UART via 3.5mm jack
                                                                 LED: Power LED (green), ESM Fault LED (amber),
                                                                 UID LED (blue)
                                                                 Button: Power button




                                      Enterprise-Class Quality. Cloud Economics.

North America: (Toll Free) +1 888 899 9998   |   Global: +1 416 448 5800   |   contactus@celestica.com   |   celestica.com

SD6200 4U 90 HDD Dense Storage SAS-4 Expansion System




POWER AND COOLING                                                                        APPROVALS

  1300W 80 plus Platinum PSU, 2+2 (200-240V) or                                               EMC: EN 55032 Class A, EN55024, EN 61000-3-2,
  3+1 (100-240V) redundant, hot swap                                                          EN 61000-3-3, FCC part 15 Class A, VCCI Class A,
                                                                                              ICES-003 Class A, GB/T9254 Class A
  100-127,200-240V AC input, auto ranging, 47~63Hz
                                                                                              Safety: IEC/EN/UL/CSA 62368-1, GB4943
  5 x 80 mm dual rotor fans, hot-pluggable
  from the top                                                                                Environment: RoHS, REACH, WEEE, ERP Lot9
PHYSICAL DIMENSIONS
                                                                                         Note: All specifications and figures are subject to change
  Height: 175.3 mm (6.9”)                                                                without prior notice.

  Width: 448 mm (17.64”)
  Depth: 1070 mm (42.12”) w/CMA
ENVIRONMENTAL
  Operating Temperature: 5°C to 35°C
  Non-operating Temperature: -40°C to 60°C
  Humidity: 8% to 80% RH
  Altitude: 0 to 950 m (De-rate temperature 1°C per
  300 m above 950 m)
  Sound Power: (23+/-2°C) <7.6Bel
